# Adoption

Without `--check`, the compat-only spellings are rewritten in place. Everything
else in the file stays byte for byte as it was. A project declaring anything
`unsupported` is refused; no partial conversion takes place.

The `atlas://` migration-directory reference is one compat-only spelling. It
becomes an `oci://` reference to the same artifact in the registry namespace
set by `PTAH_ATLAS_REGISTRY`. If that variable is unset, the analysis reports
the missing namespace and does not invent a repository.

# Directory selection

The default applies only when no other layer names a directory. `--dir`,
`PTAH_DIR`, `PTAH_MIGRATIONS_DIR`, and `atlas.hcl` `migration.dir` all override
it. If the directory named by `--dir` does not exist, the command fails; it
does not fall back to `./migrations`.

# Registry scope

Login, the Atlas Registry, the Cloud UI, monitoring, and the Cloud APIs are
account-bound services outside the Atlas OSS drop-in scope. Ptah still
supports artifact publishing and promotion through any OCI registry.
